Setting remove_navigation to false preserves nav and aside elements

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"preprocessing\":{\"remove_navigation\":false}}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<nav>SiteMenu</nav><main><p>MainContent</p></main><aside>SidebarText</aside>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
